净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Volatility-adjusted price impact using a shorter window for impact (10 days) to respond more quickly to liquidity shifts, and range-based ATR normalized by close for more robust volatility scaling. Preserves core liquidity/impact economic mechanism while targeting improved IC and RankIC.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

ts_mean(10, |ret|/vol) / (ts_atr(20)/close)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

ts_mean(10, |ret|/vol) / (ts_atr(20)/close)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：col('ret') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）
  2. 步骤2：abs(v1(col)) → 计算绝对值
  3. 步骤3：col('Volume') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）
  4. 步骤4：divide(v2(abs), v3(col)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  5. 步骤5：ts_mean(v4(divide)) → 窗口 10 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  6. 步骤6：col('AdjHigh') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）
  7. 步骤7：col('AdjLow') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）
  8. 步骤8：col('AdjClose') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）
  9. 步骤9：true_range(v6(col), v7(col), v8(col)) → 真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)
  10. 步骤10：ts_mean(v9(true_range)) → 窗口 20 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  11. 步骤11：col('AdjClose') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）
  12. 步骤12：divide(v10(ts_mean), v11(col)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  13. 步骤13：divide(v5(ts_mean), v12(divide)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 high：high
  3. 计算 low：low
  4. 计算 volume：volume
  5. 计算 ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1.0
  6. 计算 abs_ret：ret.abs()
  7. 计算 impact：abs_ret / volume
  8. 计算 avg_impact：impact.滚动窗口(10, min_periods=10).mean()
  9. 计算 tr：np.maximum(high - low, np.maximum((high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs()))
  10. 计算 atr：tr.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).mean()
  11. 计算 atr_normalized：atr / close
  12. 计算 factor：avg_impact / atr_normalized
  13. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_impact_volatility_adjusted_v2(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] ret = close / close.shift(1) - 1.0 abs_ret = ret.abs() "com"># Shorter window "kw">class="kw">for price impact to capture recent liquidity changes impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan) avg_impact = impact.rolling(10, min_periods=10).mean() "com"># Range-based volatility using ATR normalized by close - more robust tr = np.maximum(high - low, np.maximum((high - close.shift(1)).abs(), (low - close.shift(1)).abs())) atr = tr.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean() atr_normalized = atr / close "com"># Volatility-adjusted impact factor = avg_impact / atr_normalized.replace(0, np.nan) factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_volatility_adjusted_v2'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_volatility_adjusted_v2']
